question:
DRAG DROP -
A network engineer must configure FCoE on an interface of a Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switch. It should be used for mapping between VLAN 600 and VLAN 6.
Drag and drop the commands from the bottom into their implementation order in the FCoE configuration. Not all commands are used.
theory: Building FCoE on an MDS/Nexus interface follows a fixed sequence: map the FCoE VLAN to its VSAN under the VLAN itself ('fcoe vsan 6'), allow both the native VLAN (1) and the FCoE VLAN (600) on the trunk carrying the CNA's converged traffic ('switchport trunk allowed vlan 1,600'), and finally, in the VSAN database, add the already-created and Ethernet-bound vfc interface as a member of its VSAN ('vsan 6 interface vfc 6') so it participates in Fibre Channel switching. Getting the VLAN-VSAN mapping location or the trunk's allowed-VLAN list wrong is the typical failure point in FCoE bring-up. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 9 - FCoE Implementation)
